prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: final game-environment illustration derived from an actual validated 3D camera render of an island academy.
Input image: authoritative 3D render edit target. Preserve its camera, perspective, building footprints, heights, count, roof shapes, path topology, doors and windows, and the exact broad volcano ridge silhouette and relative scale.
Primary request: transform the plain 3D materials and sparse render into a beautifully finished, believable hand-painted game environment illustration, with carefully rendered natural materials and atmosphere. Do not redesign the architecture. This is a 1.7 metre eye-level view from the interior oath court northward: central circular stone hall with pale patinated-copper dome dominates the foreground, modest slate-roof academic buildings at left and behind, white lime wall/terracotta eave at extreme left edge, real broad grassy volcanic outer slope and crater rim across the backdrop. The crater lake is hidden behind the ridge: do not invent a crater opening or water in this view.
Refinements: precisely scaled weathered basalt masonry with subtle warm/cool variation and thin mortar; aged oak plank door, fine window frames and cool dark glazing; restrained verdigris on copper dome with its existing thin ribs; real small slate tiles; stone pavement matching all existing edges, with fine joints and sparse grass at the verge; natural Atlantic grass on the slopes, occasional small exposed basalt patches that follow slope direction; existing small hydrangea clusters rendered as soft blue/purple flower heads. Keep courtyard and circulation open. Mountains have detailed grass/rock surface and light atmospheric depth, but retain the SAME height, slope and ridge outline; they must remain clearly visible and not disappear into fog. Southwest afternoon sunlight, readable short shadows, restrained pale blue clouded Atlantic sky. Quiet mysterious 1890–1910 academy, functioning and weathered rather than ruined. Professionally painted architectural concept art, rich tactile surfaces, crisp foreground architectural detail, landscape 16:9.
Constraints: no people; no text; no added towers, wings, steps, entrances, roof levels, buildings, gates or altered placement. No huge trees covering buildings; no fantasy runes; no smoke plume or cone-shaped volcano; no wide-angle distortion; no image borders or UI; no watermarks. Preserve framing and architectural silhouette; enrich surfaces rather than alter forms.
purpose: art illustration from actual Blender 3D eye-level camera; rendered model remains exact source of geometry
observed_deviations: Generated image introduces extra fine steps/stone details and changes fine surface markings; do not use as geometry verification
The crater lake is hidden and not depicted
